The card controls screen is built in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

It shows the card name and last four digits, a freeze switch, three toggle rows (online payments, contactless, international use), and a daily spending limit slider. When frozen, a notice appears and the controls section is visually dimmed and disabled (`aria-disabled`, `disabled` on inputs) until unfrozen. Styling uses Strata's CSS token variables (with sensible fallbacks since `@strata/react`/`@strata/tokens` aren't installed in this sandbox to inspect) and logical CSS properties (`margin-inline-start`, `border-block-end`, etc.) so it adapts correctly to RTL locales, dark scheme, and density.

Note: since `@strata/react` component exports weren't available locally to verify, I used semantic HTML (buttons with `role="switch"`, native `<input type="range">`) rather than guessing at Strata component APIs, to keep the build reliable.
